evidence: Windows CPython 3.11: pip --dry-run --ignore-installed resolved all declared extras to 134 distributions. Direct-package metadata and installed-distribution LICENSE/NOTICE files were inspected where available; exact files are recorded per package. This is an inventory, not legal advice.

asyncua.effect: Optional OPC UA adapter. Keep dynamically installed and provide the LGPL notice; do not statically combine it.
asyncua.commercial: The commercial Fullseye license does not replace asyncua's LGPL obligations.

astropy.effect: Test-only export verifier; no dependency files are bundled in the Fullseye wheel.
astropy.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

cmake.effect: Optional native-SDK build tool; installed by pip and not bundled in the Fullseye wheel. Retain both notices if its files are redistributed.
cmake.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

cupy-cuda12x.effect: Optional GPU backend; CUDA runtime terms remain a separate NVIDIA matter.
cupy-cuda12x.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

hypothesis.effect: Development-only test tool; not bundled in the wheel.
hypothesis.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

imageio.effect: Optional image I/O; installed by pip, not bundled.
imageio.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

imageio-ffmpeg.effect: Optional video adapter. Its separately distributed FFmpeg executable has its own notices and must remain replaceable.
imageio-ffmpeg.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

kornia.effect: Optional GPU vision backend; installed by pip, not bundled.
kornia.commercial: No additional condition from Fullseye's commercial license.

pyside6.effect: Optional today and planned default 1.2.0 GUI dependency. Fullseye imports it dynamically only when Studio is used; do not vendor or statically link Qt/PySide. The Python environment must permit replacing PySide6/Qt, and notices plus corresponding-source information supplied by the PySide6 distributor must remain available.
